concerns.text: The plan defaults to **Synthetic Verification Mode** because no verified open‑source dataset provides both rs‑fMRI and a reliable musical‑training variable. This means FR‑001 (load real rs‑fMRI with musical‑training metadata) is not satisfied, and the analysis will not answer the core research question on real adolescent brains.

The plan defines musicians as having **≥ 2 years of training**, whereas the specification (spec.md) and user stories require a **≥ 1 year** threshold. This inconsistency changes group assignment and violates the documented data model constraints, potentially leading to mismatched labels and invalid downstream analyses.
